modelCaching.note: Set manually via the RunPod console (New Endpoint, or Manage -> Edit Endpoint on an existing one) -> Advanced settings -> Model. Verified 2026-08-09: this is a console-only setting, not yet part of the public REST v1 POST /templates or POST /endpoints schema, so it cannot be set from this file. RunPod pre-stages the model at /runpod-volume/huggingface-cache/hub/models--bosonai--higgs-tts-3-4b/... before the worker starts, and that wait is not billed. handler.py's bootstrap checks that exact path first and skips its own download entirely on a cache hit.

build.note: Run from the project root. .dockerignore strips .icm/, .goals/, .claude/, .outline/, .serena/, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md from the build context.
